title: Thackeray, Shinde acquitted in 2009 defamation case
summary: A Kalyan court has acquitted Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde in a defamation case dating back to 2009. Both leaders were involved in the legal proceedings.
title_hi: ठाकरे, शिंदे 2009 के मानहानि मामले में बरी
summary_hi: कल्याण की एक अदालत ने 2009 के मानहानि मामले में उद्धव ठाकरे और एकनाथ शिंदे को बरी कर दिया है। दोनों नेता कानूनी कार्यवाही में शामिल थे।

center: Reported the acquittal of Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde in a 2009 defamation case by a Kalyan court.
right: Reported the acquittal of Uddhav Thackeray and Eknath Shinde in a 2009 defamation case by a Kalyan court.
